svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.8.7.5 Ergonomic Design
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.8 STAIRS, RAMPS, LANDINGS, HANDRAILS AND GUARDS

g.text: Brackets from below: nothing on top

svg.text: The clearance between a handrail and the
surface behind it is not less than
All handrails are continually graspable along
their entire length, with no obstruction on or
above them to break a handhold
Fingers and thumb should be able to curl under
part or all of the handrail. If they cannot reach
the bottom, finger recesses are needed on both
Drawn: round handrails on brackets in front of a smooth wall and a rough masonry wall. Rail size is illustration only.
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.8.7.5. (page 9-37), with Note A-9.8.7.5.(2).
